title: abies concolor var. lowiana
intro: Abies concolor var. lowiana, commonly known as the Shasta fir, is a coniferous evergreen tree native to the western United States. It is valued for its fragrant, soft needles and timber. The health benefits of Abies concolor var. lowiana include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and prevent infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as terpenes, including alpha-pinene and beta-pinene, which have therapeutic actions including anti-anxiety and anti-inflammatory effects, while also providing antioxidant and anti-cancer properties.
